title: Programmatic Harness for Building Custom Claude Code-Style Agents
oneLiner: The Claude Agent SDK (formerly Claude Code SDK) exposes Anthropic's agent loop, file editing, bash execution, sub-agents, and MCP connectors as a programmable Python/TypeScript library.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: The Claude Agent SDK (formerly Claude Code SDK) exposes Anthropic's agent loop, file editing, bash execution, sub-agents, and MCP connectors as a programmable Python/TypeScript library.
